messages.content: Hi, this is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been decent out your way. Do you have a blood pressure reading to share today?
Cuff keeps saying ERR. Tried it three times. Don't know what's wrong with it.

That's a real pain — sorry you're dealing with it. Device troubleshooting is one thing I'm not set up to help with through this line. Your best bet is the support number on the back of the cuff or in the box that came with it. In the meantime, how are you feeling today? Any headaches, dizziness, or anything else going on?
No I feel fine. Normal. Just can't get a reading. Can you put in the chart that I tried?
Yes, I'll log that a reading was attempted but couldn't be completed due to a device error. Are you taking your blood pressure medications the same as usual, or has anything changed there?

Good to know. I've got the note in, and I'll set your next check-in for seven days from today. If you get the cuff sorted before then, feel free to text in a reading anytime. Otherwise we'll try again next week. Take care of yourself.

theme: blood pressure cuff shows ERR, device support
